name: 3-against-4 shaker weave
desc: 808 maracas in a {3}%4 polymeter that realigns every 3 cycles, riding the pump idiom so on-beat hits duck under the kick. Full adds a Visco hat layer in 5-against-8 with masked breathing; peak throws pitched-up cowbells into the weave with 8-bar double-time fills.

code.full: stack(s("{sh sh sh}%4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${duck}, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("{hh hh hh hh hh}%8").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").gain(${gain}*.5).mask("<1 1 1 0>").pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16))).hpf(${hcut}).lpf(9000).room(.12).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("{sh sh sh}%4").ply("<1 1 2 1>").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${duck}, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)), s("{hh hh hh hh hh}%8").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").gain(${gain}*.55).pan(cosine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)), s("{cb ~ ~ cb ~}%8").bank("RolandTR808").speed(1.2).gain(${gain}*.45).every(8, x=>x.fast(2))).hpf(${hcut}).lpf(11000).room(.12).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
